title: Tech Pressure Continues: NVDA Weekly Topping Tail Signals Pullback
speaker: Drew Dosek (Gareth Soloway's Verified Investing, 'Trading the Close')

macro_themes.view: OpenAI and AVGO comments revived worries on AI capex; investors trimming tech before earnings.
Weekly topping tail suggests yields come down in coming weeks, giving tech relief.
Administration's push to lower oil before midterms is losing; oil likely keeps rising.

calls.reason: Sideways session (-0.06%) with bond market closed; no directional call given.
calls.quote: today with the bond markets not in participation, we basically didn't do too much on the S&P 500

calls.reason: Weekly topping tail plus OpenAI/AVGO AI-capex monetization worries; trend line from March lows has held every test.
calls.quote: Any further selling on tech is going to find support right here at this inclining trend line... 26,856 points

calls.condition: If selling continues into the parallel, expects stop at 0.618 fib 576.59 then bounce to retest top of channel

calls.quote: That's where I'm anticipating uh price to stop and if not provide a near-term bounce up

calls.reason: Massive weekly topping tail and weekly + daily 'sleeper hold' signals; yield 'cooked', should come down and relieve tech.
